newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates unchanged on mill buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates unchanged on mill buying.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates remained steady on Tuesday on buying by mills and will remain pegged at these levels as the arrival of fresh supplies from the new crop have not fully picked up, dealers said.

"There was buying by mills mostly from the Punjab (province)," a dealer said. "The arrival of fresh supplies is slow in Punjab and the rates are likely to remain pegged at the current levels this week."
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted around 2,225 ($54.85) rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and the MNH-93 at 2,325, dealers said.
